overview: DeepAFL introduces a gradient-free deep residual analytic federated learning framework that constructs deep representations layer-by-layer using sandwiched least squares, achieving representation learning capabilities while maintaining ideal invariance to data heterogeneity.

modules.name: Data Partitioning & Loading
modules.description: Handles dataset preprocessing, image transformations, and the implementation of heterogeneous data partitioning strategies (Latent Dirichlet Allocation and Sharding) to simulate Non-IID scenarios across federated clients.

modules.name: Feature Initialization & Random Projection
modules.description: Implements the frozen pre-trained backbone for initial feature extraction and the subsequent construction of zero-layer features via activated random projection matrices to enhance linear separability.

modules.name: Client Local Computation
modules.description: Computes local client statistics required for aggregation, specifically the Feature Auto-Correlation, Label Cross-Correlation, Hidden Auto-Correlation, and Residual Cross-Correlation matrices based on local features and residuals.

modules.name: Analytic Classifier Solver
modules.description: Implements the server-side least squares solver for the global analytic classifier, utilizing aggregated correlation matrices to derive closed-form solutions while incorporating regularization.

modules.name: Sandwiched Least Squares Solver
modules.description: Implements the core technical innovation for solving the trainable transformation matrix in the residual block, utilizing spectral decomposition of the aggregated hidden and classifier correlation matrices to solve the sandwiched least squares optimization problem.

modules.name: Residual Feature Updating
modules.description: Implements the client-side feature update logic following the residual block structure, adding the computed residual transformation to the previous layer's features to iteratively refine representations.

modules.name: DeepAFL Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Controls the layer-wise federated training workflow, sequentially coordinating client computation, server aggregation, and model distribution for each layer from the initial layer to the target depth.

modules.name: Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the forward inference pass for a trained DeepAFL model, sequentially applying random projections, activations, and the learned transformation matrices layer-by-layer to compute the final prediction.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Provides configurable modules to evaluate the contribution of key components by selectively ablating the residual skip connection, the random projection matrix, the activation function, or the trainable transformation matrix.

modules.name: Evaluation & Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Calculates performance metrics (accuracy) and statistical significance, while also profiling computational cost (wall-clock time) and communication overhead (transmitted matrix sizes) to compare against gradient-based baselines.

modules.name: Configuration & Reproducibility
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations (hyperparameters, dataset settings) and ensures strict control over random seeds for all projection matrices to guarantee the theoretical invariance properties and reproducibility of results.
